official_corroboration: Parity classes are valid independent sets.
When L is odd and R is even, the optimum is n/2 or n/2+1 according to parity/highest-differing-bit structure.
In the connected/perfect-matching branch, a perfect matching supplies the matching upper bound.
Exact subproblem is minimum-cost size-4 matching between T-root branches and U-root branches.
Naively materializing O(N) edges per root is too slow.
Official solution reduces edges and uses HLD/DSU-on-tree style recoloring plus segment tree; O(N log^2 N).
f(P)=sum min(L_i,R_i), matching the frozen derivation.
The diagonal hypergeometric/binomial sum computed naively for every j is TLE.
Official solution accelerates the diagonal terms by divide-and-conquer plus convolution to O(N log^2 N).
